description: Defines mock classes for asynchronous proxy resolution, including MockAsyncProxyResolver, MockAsyncProxyResolverFactory, and ForwardingProxyResolver, used for testing proxy resolution behavior.

classes.name: MockAsyncProxyResolver
classes.description: A mock implementation of an asynchronous proxy resolver for testing purposes.

classes.name: MockAsyncProxyResolver::Job
classes.description: Represents a proxy resolution job that can be completed asynchronously.

classes.name: MockAsyncProxyResolver::RequestImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ProxyResolver::Request for mock proxy resolution.

classes.name: MockAsyncProxyResolverFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create mock proxy resolvers for testing.

classes.name: MockAsyncProxyResolverFactory::Request
classes.description: Represents a request to create a mock proxy resolver.

classes.name: ForwardingProxyResolver
classes.description: A proxy resolver that forwards requests to another resolver.

methods.name: CompleteNow
methods.description: Completes a proxy resolution job immediately with a specified result.

methods.name: GetProxyForURL
methods.description: Retrieves proxy information for a given URL asynchronously.
